invalidation_rules: Any incorrect recovery, accepted corrupt certificate, differing successful same-threshold repeat certificate or cross-threshold scalar, failed sanitizer or unexpected process error invalidates the run. Explicit limits/timeouts are frontier observations, not invalidity.

decision_rule.text: Report all exact recoveries, relation/query counts and descriptive L0 clocks. Same m12 implementation and public inputs; explicit threshold changes factor-base size. Two52-bit A/A repeats; no population inference. Sparse bases can require more queries; per-trial cap128*(columns+1), max16trials. No Lemma10 coverage guarantee invoked; explicit thresholds may be below sufficient10m. No cross-panel causal timing claim.

literature.claim: Paper reduction has factor bases,relation collection,linear algebra and extraction; claimed asymptotic contraction is conditional and not practical-curve speed evidence.
Point order divides group order; Hasse interval bounds full cardinality. Exact prime torsion witness and unique multiple certify cofactor one.

Lower-bound on a sorted full-key range preserves first equal entry; prefix ranges are bounded with the same comparator. This is an engineering index, not a new decomposition algorithm.

literature.claim: On a fixed odd-prime curve, x and y parity encode a point exactly; infinity is separate. Internal key2*(x+1)+(y&1) with infinity0 fits u64 under p<2^62. This is exact compression, not a hash or new algorithm.
literature.verified_by: Read SEC1 v2 primary standard section2.3.3 on2026-10-30 before implementation; inspected canonical affine conversion and validated service inputs.

literature.claim: Random memory access limits throughput; assess realistic complete workloads. A larger index narrows exact binary search at an explicitly charged setup and storage cost. This is conventional indexing, not a new decomposition algorithm.
literature.verified_by: Read official NVIDIA guide and existing prefix kernels2026-10-30 before this change.

literature.claim: Naturally aligned accesses are required; unaligned8/16-byte loads can produce incorrect results. Three u32 words provide exact12-byte storage without unaligned u64 loads; multiple loads may affect performance, so assess full workload.
literature.verified_by: Read primary CUDA13 guide global-memory size/alignment section2026-10-30; inspected current exact key/tuple-ID bounds before implementation.

literature.claim: Bounded grid-stride traversal reuses threads; atomically stopping only tiles above an existing witness preserves the exact minimum without cross-block waiting.
literature.verified_by: Read NVIDIA guidance and device-scope atomic memory semantics before implementation; see PERSISTENT-QUERY.md.

literature.claim: Reuse invariant data when memory permits, and charge construction/storage to the full workload. Exact right sums are independent of each relation target.
